Name: [Project] Money measures are shown in reais (R$)
Description: olist-analytics: every amount comes from Brazilian orders in BRL. A revenue, freight, price, payment, spend or CLV measure needs an R$ format string, so a card never shows a bare number or a $ sign. Shares, %, counts, labels and colours are not amounts.
Expression: RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)revenue|freight|price|payment|spend|clv|aov") and not RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)%|share|label|color|alt text|count|customers in") and not FormatString.Contains("R$")
